name: AppleAnimate
summary: Plays keyframe animations on rigged models from code (no uploads): loops, on click, on a prompt, on touch, on a real key press or once, with easing and an optional sound per clip. Models are rigged the RigEdit way (Motor6Ds to an anchored root, pivots on the hinges).

needs.model: a Model in Workspace whose moving parts are joined to an anchored root by Motor6Ds named after the parts (rig_model), with pivots on the hinges (set_joint_pivot)
needs.animations: a ModuleScript named AppleAnimations inside the model returning { clip = { play, length, keys, sound?, prompt?, reach? } }

gives.motion: the joints move by C0 from their rest, so every player sees the same motion
gives.interaction: ClickDetector, ProximityPrompt or Touched starts a clip; a clip named Part.clip starts from that part only
gives.signal: ReplicatedStorage.AppleAnimatePlayed (model, clip) to every client whenever a clip plays
gives.pressed: ServerStorage.AppleAnimatePressed (player, model, clip), a server BindableEvent, whenever a player sets a clip off
